title: Smooth cutoff of a test form between two disjoint closed sets
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (ω : TestFormOn U k) (C₀ C₁ : Set (Eucl P)), IsClosed C₀ → IsClosed C₁ → Disjoint C₀ C₁ → ∃ ω' : TestFormOn U k, (∃ N₀ : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N₀ ∧ C₀ ⊆ N₀ ∧ ∀ x ∈ N₀, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x = 0) ∧ (∃ N₁ : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N₁ ∧ C₁ ⊆ N₁ ∧ ∀ x ∈ N₁, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x = (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ∧ tsupport (ω' : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ⊆ tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ∧ ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x - (ω' : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x)
